A '''Chromostring Dispenser''' was a medical tool. It was used to administer [[chromostring]] to patients. Chromostring Dispensers were included in [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries']] [[FastFlesh medpac/Legends|FastFlesh medpac]].<ref name="EGWT" />
